objects.name: Sagittarius A*
objects.modelScaleDescription: One model unit is one Schwarzschild radius derived from the adopted 4.297 million solar masses; disk appearance and orientation are illustrated
objects.description: The Milky Way’s central black hole at its real catalog direction and adopted GRAVITY distance. The closeup uses a compiled nonrotating lens model with an illustrated accretion flow.
objects.limitations: Schwarzschild reference model; not a spin measurement or reconstruction of the EHT image. Accretion geometry, orientation, colors and time are illustrated.

distanceSource.note: GRAVITY Collaboration (2022) adopted fit, with separate statistical/systematic uncertainties; not claimed to be the latest fit
